description: The Java Development Kit: the compiler, the launcher, jshell and the standard library you need to write and run Java programs.
The compiler that reads .java source files, reports errors and writes .class files containing bytecode.
The Java Virtual Machine, the program that loads compiled classes and executes their bytecode.
The entry point with the signature public static void main(String[] args) that the java launcher calls to start a program.
Running java File.java, which compiles the named source file and runs it right away, meant for small programs.
An interactive tool that evaluates Java expressions and statements one at a time, without a class or a main method.
